changelog:
• 🧹 Storage Hygiene & Auto-Purge: Automatically deletes P2P torrent cache files on stream exit and app startup, preventing multi-gigabyte disk leaks
• 💾 Cache Ceiling & Low-Storage Guard: Reduced media cache cap to 200 MB and added auto-trim protection when device disk space drops below 500 MB
• ⚙️ In-App Storage Manager: New 'Device Storage & App Cache' section in Settings displaying real-time app cache and free space with a 'Clear Cache Now' button
• 📜 Infinite Scroll Fix: Resolved infinite horizontal scroll pagination issues for HF Direct and Movies category rows
• 📦 Updater Permission Fix: Handled Unknown App Sources permission prompt and URI permissions for seamless in-app APK installation
• 🎬 130% Home Trailer Zoom: Centered 130% zoom on the home screen spotlight video for a borderless, cinematic appearance
